scope: The aquatic Marisa hat: outside the land hat's cone tiers turned round under its own bent tip, band and bow; set down it is the worn hat flipped at the same size (round, 1.0x; user 2026-11-01), a lily pad on the water: a fixed presentation waterline 0.5 model units under the brim face, the brim level from the opening then falling to the water with its edge just under it (no raised rim), the base tier upright round a dry basin below the water, the lower tiers pressed into a keel. aquatic_basin_hat is the worn and item mesh (accessory_marisa frame), aquatic_basin_hat_turned the set-down hull (marisa_hat_turned frame, already pressed). hull_bounds holds the plain sizes the game places and draws by (waterline, mouth, floor, brim, keel, the captain's stern seat, the brim ring for a sitting child, the stores texture tiers). The stores texture reuses the existing 16x16 food_layer.png unchanged. Project design: tiers are total stored portions [from, to]; tier 0 draws nothing. For each other tier, f = radius_fractions[tier], R = basin floor radius: disc radius f*R, centre (x=0, z=-(1-f)*R), tangent to the bow-side wall (-Z), before the captain. Fixed hull-space UVs (+X right, +Z down), repeating at 16 pixels per block; smaller discs crop the same texture without stretching. Project design; visual review remains pending.
